answer: The marble holds work receipts rather than names, so the gale of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Reaching the summit of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, re-queued for a second panel, no identity may audit its own recruit.
